question: Bihu is a folk dance of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Assam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Bihu dance is an indigenous **folk dance from the Indian state of Assam **related to the Bihu festival and an** important part of Assamese culture.**
 
• The **Bihu dance** takes its name from the **Bohag Bihu festival **also called Rangali Bihu,the **national festival of Assam**, which celebrates the Assamese New Year</stro
